title: NASA people study the phenomenon and travel with him
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of NASA people study the phenomenon and travel with him, about 2007-present at Various, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Yeah. We love them. And uh but there are a lot of other NASA guys that I'm currently talking with.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says strange lights and craft appear around him, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that since about 2007 people from NASA, the US space agency, have studied what happens around him and travelled with him. He names some of them and says there are many other NASA people he is talking with now. If true, it would mean people inside a major government agency are quietly looking into these experiences.
